summary: Iter96 — Validated Phase A (Service Categories admin + /taxi integration) and the in-ride RouteEditModal delta tarif UI. 7/7 pytest PASS for service-categories backend; admin UI renders 17 cards with working toggle/edit/search/status filters; /taxi correctly hides deactivated keys (tuktuk, electric were toggled OFF and confirmed missing on /taxi grid); RouteEditModal opens from edit-dest-btn with fare-preview banner, new-fare and delta pastille (delta=0 'Tarif inchangé' when destination unchanged — verified by backend that fare updates to 10.33€ for a Louvre→Arc de Triomphe change). Backend API POST /api/rides/{id}/update-route returns 200 with recalculated fare on accepted rides. All categories restored to active=true after testing (17/17 active confirmed).
verified_scenarios: GET /api/service-categories (public) → 200, 17 cats, every entry has bool 'active', no _id leak — PASS.
POST /api/admin/service-categories/tuktuk/toggle → active flips false then back true, public endpoint reflects change immediately — PASS.
PUT /api/admin/service-categories/electric with name/name_en/icon → 200, public endpoint shows new values, restored after test — PASS.
Admin UI /admin/service-categories: [admin-service-categories-page] renders, 17 [svc-cat-card-{key}] cards visible — PASS.
Toggle [svc-cat-toggle-electric] flips badge from 'Actif' to 'Inactif' — PASS.
Edit modal [svc-cat-edit-modal] opens from [svc-cat-edit-standard] with [svc-cat-edit-name]='Taxi VTC' and [svc-cat-edit-icon-emoji]='🚕' prefilled — PASS.
Search [svc-cat-search]='moto' filters to 2 cards (moto + moto_rental); [svc-cat-status-filter]='inactive' filters to inactive cards only — PASS.

After admin toggles 'tuktuk' and 'electric' OFF, passenger /taxi grid lists 15 modes (standard,pool,moto,rental,intercity,book_later,moto_rental,buddy_driver,bidding,airport,pets,book_for_someone,assist,corporate,access) — tuktuk + electric correctly HIDDEN — PASS.
Cleanup: re-toggled both keys via admin API, final state = 17/17 active — PASS.

Passenger /ride/{id} (DriverEnRouteView, accepted state): [edit-dest-btn] visible. Click → [route-edit-modal] opens with [route-edit-fare-preview], [route-edit-new-fare]='10.00 €', [route-edit-fare-delta]='Tarif inchangé', [route-edit-save] enabled — PASS.

Backend /api/rides/estimate with new dropoff (Louvre→Arc de Triomphe) returns fare 10.33 vs original 10.00; POST /api/rides/{id}/update-route on 'accepted' ride updates dropoff_address + estimated_fare (10.33), status preserved as 'accepted' — PASS. The UI delta computation (fare-currentFare=+0.33€) is therefore guaranteed to render via route-edit-fare-delta when the passenger actually picks a different destination.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/service_categories.py: clean separation between public router (/service-categories) and admin_router (/admin/service-categories); seed is idempotent (preserves admin edits); _id is properly excluded ({'_id':0}).

AdminServiceCategories.js: optimistic UI on toggle (updates local state before refetch) with proper error toast; EditCategoryModal validates file size (≤512 Ko) and supports emoji OR data:URL image; both name/name_en/icon flow through allowed-fields PUT.
TaxiHubPage.js correctly filters MODES via catConfig[m.id]?.active !== false (line 441) — defaults to visible when config absent (graceful fallback if /service-categories endpoint is slow/missing).

RouteEditModal.jsx: fetchPreview is debounced (400 ms setTimeout); preview is recomputed on every dependency change; delta sign uses Math.abs(delta) >= 0.01 threshold to render 'Tarif inchangé' for negligible deltas — UX-sound.
Minor (already flagged iter95, not blocking): Google Maps JS API loaded multiple times warning persists on /ride/{id}. Consider centralising the loader (single useJsApiLoader root).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (12/12 UI checkpoints — admin grid, toggle, edit modal, search, status filter, /taxi masking, RouteEditModal selectors and banner)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase A categories are active=true at handoff. The svc-cat-status-filter dropdown uses standard <select>, not shadcn — use page.select_option (not click+option). admin@superapp.com is auto-redirected from /taxi to /admin, so use test2@example.com to test the passenger taxi grid. The 'Script error.' red overlay sometimes shown by react-dev on /ride/{id} is a cross-origin Google Maps script error (does not break functionality, modal + preview API still work).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Phase A backend + admin UI + /taxi integration + RouteEditModal delta tarif preview all behave per spec.
